caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned upright and shown from the front. The chair features two horizontal slats on the backrest, each bordered in blue, with a natural wood grain texture in the center. The vertical supports of the backrest are brown and connect to the seat, which appears to have a woven pattern in yellowish and brown tones. The legs of the chair are turned, showcasing cylindrical and rounded segments in shades of brown and yellow. The chair has four legs, with the front two being more decorative and the back two simpler and slightly angled. There are two horizontal stretchers supporting the legs, one connecting the front legs and another stretching from side to side. The background is plain and light beige, offering contrast to the chair and making it the central focus of the composition.
title: Empire Chair (American)
